title: Principal, Software Architect
jobDescription: Job Description You are a well-rounded software professional with at least 15 years of experience designing, developing, deploying and monitoring enterprise applications. You are skilled in building software applications using the modern technologies including Java, Spring and related technologies. You have an additional responsibility to lead the implementation and support engineering manager in day-to-day operations of the team. You have a successful track record that demonstrates your ability to work in teams and deliver projects on time in a dynamic and agile environment. Responsibilities Define, own, and execute the enterprise platform architecture strategy, ensuring complete alignment between long-term business goals and technology roadmaps. Create, manage, and govern all service blueprints within the designated technical domain to serve as the single source of truth for engineering teams. Establish and enforce architecture standards, best practices, governance frameworks, and design principles across all engineering verticals. Lead architecture reviews, perform rigorous technology evaluations, and provide formal solution design approvals to ensure enterprise alignment. Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture to make critical technical decisions, ensuring they are documented transparently for long-term auditability and traceability. Guarantee the consistent delivery of highly scalable, available, and resilient solutions by mandating the use of enterprise architecture patterns and frameworks. Lead large-scale application modernization initiatives, with a primary focus on driving monolithic-to-microservices transformations. Architect secure, distributed, and highly available cloud-native solutions leveraging modern technologies, specifically Java, Angular, and Microservices. Design and oversee the implementation of sophisticated API-first, event-driven, and distributed system architectures across the enterprise. Author architecture-driven investment roadmaps for the domain, partnering with Enterprise Architecture to build business cases and justify funding priorities. Partner closely with business stakeholders, product owners, and engineering leads to translate complex business requirements into tangible technical execution. Drive public cloud adoption (AWS, Azure, or GCP), infrastructure optimization, and overall platform scalability in collaboration with infrastructure, network, and operations teams. Define enterprise-wide CI/CD, DevSecOps automation, comprehensive observability, and site reliability engineering (SRE) strategies to ensure security and compliance throughout the lifecycle. Lead critical technical decisions and risk assessments while mentoring domain architects and senior engineers to foster a culture of engineering excellence and continuous innovation. Knowledge and Skills – Required This is an individual contributor role and you are expected to code for at least 50% of the time. Solid understanding of the modern application patterns & deployment methods. Minimum of 15 years of Strong Experience in Software Engineering, Enterprise Architecture and Design, and hands on Technical skills (Java, data base designs) with the ability to guide developers for the optimal solution around technical challenges. Should have experience on Java, Spring (ORM, Security, MVC, AOP). Should have experience with cloud solutions (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform etc.) Should have experience on Experience on data intensive applications built with SQL/NoSQL DBs and designed data schema. Experience on building microservices based application integrations using REST and API gateways. Should have experience on Relational Database (SQL, PL/SQL) and NoSQL like Cassandra, Apache Ignite, Neo4j or Elasticsearch. Good to have Helm charts, Github actions Should have knowledge of Continuous integration and continuous deployment (CD/CI) using Git and Jenkins or Azure DevOps. Delivery using modern methodologies especially SAFe Agile, Iterative Excellent analytical skills applied in a practical environment. Well organized, disciplined approach to work with a high level of attention to detail Strong work ethics with high level of self-motivation Experience in working in large cross functional projects and product development. Strong ability to navigate across teams to resolve challenges. title: Engineer I, Embededd Software Test
jobDescription: Position Overview: We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented Firmware Verification and Validation Engineer to join our team. As a Firmware Verification and Validation Engineer, you will play a critical role in ensuring the quality and reliability of our firmware used in UPS systems. Your primary responsibility will be to design, implement, and execute test strategies and plans to validate firmware functionality, performance, and adherence to specifications. Your expertise will contribute to identifying and resolving firmware-related issues, ensuring the smooth operation of our products throughout their lifecycle. Responsibilities: Collaborate with the firmware development team to define comprehensive test strategies that cover functional, performance, and reliability aspects of the firmware. Design and create detailed test plans, including test cases and test scripts, based on firmware requirements and specifications. Execute tests on target hardware platforms, ensuring the proper functioning and compatibility of firmware with the hardware. Develop and maintain test automation frameworks and scripts to optimize testing efficiency and enhance test coverage, with a focus on automated system firmware testing. Identify, investigate, and report firmware defects using issue tracking systems, such as JIRA, and proficiently manage the end-to-end defect lifecycle. Work closely with the development team to prioritize and resolve identified issues, providing timely feedback and updates to stakeholders. Analyse and debug firmware issues using appropriate debugging tools, such as oscilloscopes, logic analysers, and software debugging tools. Analyse test results and provide meaningful feedback to the firmware development team, suggesting improvements and optimizations for enhanced firmware performance and stability. Create and maintain detailed documentation related to test plans, test cases, test procedures, and test reports. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including firmware developers, hardware engineers, quality assurance teams, and product managers, to ensure a comprehensive verification and validation process. Continuously research and explore emerging testing methodologies, tools, and technologies to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of firmware verification and validation processes, particularly in the field of automated system firmware testing. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Electronics and Communication, Embedded system, Electrical /Electronics Engineering, or a related field. 3 to 5 years of experience in embedded systems firmware testing and verification. Required Skills: Proven experience in firmware verification and validation in the embedded systems domain. Solid understanding of firmware development principles, including knowledge of programming languages such as C/C++ for embedded systems. Proficiency in test methodologies, test case design, and test automation frameworks, with specific experience in automated system firmware testing. Familiarity with hardware testing tools, such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and JTAG debuggers. Knowledge of software development tools, such as integrated development environments (IDEs) and version control systems. Knowledge of integrating data loggers, power analyzers, and other relevant test equipment to automate system testing for power electronics products. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen attention to detail. Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively within cross-functional teams. Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment. Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python for test automation and analysis. Experience with LabVIEW for hardware-in-the-loop testing and automated test system development. Strong JIRA management skills, including the ability to create, manage, and track issues, defects, and project tasks efficiently. Let us learn about you! Apply today. jobDescription: Company Overview Schneider Electric is a global leader in energy management and automation, delivering innovative solutions that ensure Life Is On for everyone, everywhere, and at every moment. As part of our growing digital ecosystem, we are strengthening our technical support capabilities for EcoStruxure Building Activate (EBA)—a cloud-connected, nextgeneration building automation platform used worldwide. We are seeking a highly skilled L4 Product Support Engineer to join our advanced support organization and ensure the reliability, stability, and continuous improvement of our building automation solutions in the field. title: Product Test Leader, Senior Engineer II
jobDescription: GIGA Labs is part of Innovation & Technology Labs, based out in Bangalore . We are part of Global Labs in Schneider network with various accreditations like NABL, UL, DEKRA, ASTA …. We have more than 70+ Engineers working on various technologies in Electrical , Mechanical, Electronics , Digital, Prototyping , Environmental, Microgrids on multiple product categories. We are looking for an Engineering expert engineer with expertise in Circuit breaker , Switchboard , busways , & distribution box . This person would work with cross functional teams , global labs and marketing on upcoming technologies and new innovations in Schneider Electric . This position gives exposure to experiment & explore , develop new ideas both in electrical and data science field . As an Subject matter expert , you would be responsible for the Verification and validation of project . You would be planning , monitoring, estimating , and control of activities in lab & external labs . At the outset of the project, you in collaboration with the other stakeholders, devise the test objectives, organizational test policies, test strategies and test plans. You would also be working with other labs across globe on various strategies. You would have the opportunity to work on Data Science , Agile , ISO17025, six sigma .You would directly report to lab Manager and would be based out in Bangalore . Guide and Train PTLs and Test Engineers: Offer technical expertise and training to PTLs and test engineers. Analyze Test Results and Provide Reports: Analyze the results of tests conducted and prepare detailed reports on findings. This helps in identifying any issues or areas for improvement. Collaborate with Design and Engineering Teams: Work closely with design and engineering teams to ensure the development of efficient and reliable products. This collaboration helps in aligning testing requirements with product development. Stay Up-to-Date with Industry Trends: Keep yourself updated with industry trends, advancements, and standards related to circuit breaker and switchboard testing. Pitch Webinars and Trainings: Collaborate with the marketing team to pitch webinars and training sessions for both internal teams and customers. This helps in sharing knowledge and promoting the expertise of your lab. Adherence to Safety Protocols: Ensure strict adherence to safety protocols and regulations during testing activities. Safety is of utmost importance in a lab environment. This helps in developing the skills and knowledge of your team members. Build Network with Labs: Establish a strong network and collaborate with other labs such as UL, CPRI, and ERDA. This helps in sharing knowledge, best practices, and staying updated with industry developments. Participate in Technical Presentations: Represent Schneider Electric and participate in various technical presentations at different platforms. This helps in showcasing the expertise of your lab and promoting the company. Track Standards Development and Gap Analysis: Keep track of developments in standards and analyze any gaps in competency and infrastructure. This helps in identifying areas for improvement and staying ahead in the industry. Support Lab Automation Projects: Support the team in implementing lab automation projects. Automation can improve efficiency and accuracy in testing processes. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field. Have rich experience in testing and inspection of circuit breakers and switchboards. Thorough Understanding of IEC61439 -1, IEC 61439-2, IEC 61439-3, IEC 61439-6, IEC60947-1, EC60947-2, IEC60947-3, IEC60947-4, IEC60898, IEC61009 , IEC61008 Thorough with National Electrical code , earthing systems, and wiring rules. Strong project management skills Familiarity with industry standards such as IEC, ANSI, and UL. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. title: GM – Organization-Wide Technical Skill Development
jobDescription: Lauritz Knudsen Electrical and Automation is a pioneering electrical and automation brand with a rich legacy of over 70 years in India. We offer comprehensive portfolio of low-voltage switchgear, medium-voltage switchgear, automation solutions, software, and services catering to diverse segments, including homes, agriculture, buildings, infrastructure, and industry. This position will be for Vadodara Plant for Lauritz Knudsen Electrical & Automation (A unit of Schneider Electric India Pvt. Ltd.) Designation: GM – Organization-Wide Technical Skill Development Experience: 15-18+ years of experience in the Switchgear Industry, with at least 5 years in a leadership role, either in Technical Training, R&D, or Manufacturing Operations. Position Summary The Lead for Technical Skill Development will spearhead the creation and implementation of a comprehensive, company-wide technical competency framework. This role is responsible for upskilling the technical workforce (engineering, R&D, manufacturing, and field service) in Low Voltage switchgear products (ACB, MCCB, MCB, Panels, Switchboards) and modern manufacturing processes (IoT, automation). The goal is to build a high-performance culture, reduce R&D-to-production transfer time, improve quality, and standardize technical processes across all plants in India. Key Accountabilities & Responsibilities: Strategic & Technical Leadership Competency Mapping: Define role-based technical competencies for engineering, production, quality, and R&D roles (e.g., design engineers, testing technicians, assembly line workers). Technical Roadmap: Develop a multi-year technical skill development strategy aligned with the company’s product roadmap, focusing on IEC standards, 61439 panel solutions, and digital switchgear technologies. Knowledge Management: Create a structured repository for technical knowledge, standardizing design practices, and ensuring "lessons learned" are implemented across projects. Training Design & Implementation Curriculum Development: Design, curate, and implement technical training modules for LV Switchgear design, manufacturing, testing, and troubleshooting. Hands-on Training: Lead practical, hands-on sessions for technicians on switchgear assembly, testing protocols, and safety procedures. Modern Training Methods: Implement hybrid learning solutions, including e-learning platforms, virtual reality (VR) simulations for complex assembly, and classroom workshops. Onboarding: Develop a rigorous technical induction program for new engineering and production hires. Operational & Cross-Functional Coordination Location Coordination: Coordinate training across different plants and R&D centres in India to ensure consistency and standardize operating procedures. Subject Matter Expert (SME) Liaison: Work closely with R&D, QA, Manufacturing, and Engineering heads to ensure training content is up to date with new product introductions and engineering changes. External Training: Collaborate with external industry experts, technical institutes, and consultants for specialized training. Assessment & Effectiveness Measurement TNA (Training Needs Analysis): Conduct individual and team skills gap analyses regularly. ROI/Impact Measurement: Evaluate training effectiveness through metrics, such as reduced rework, faster troubleshooting, and improved productivity in manufacturing. Certification: Implement certification programs to recognize technical expertise within the organization. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Percentage of employees certified under the technical competency framework. Reduction in manufacturing rework or quality issues attributed to skill gaps. Reduction in time-to-market for new products (R&D to production training efficiency). Training hours per employee (technical). Adherence to the Annual Training Calendar. Required Candidate Profile: Education & Experience Education: B.E./ B.Tech in Electrical/Electronics/Mechanical/Production Engineering (essential). M.Tech in Power Systems/Electrical Engineering/Mechanical Engineering is a plus. Experience: 15-18+ years of experience in the Switchgear Industry, with at least 5 years in a leadership role, either in Technical Training, R&D, or Manufacturing Operations. Knowledge: Deep understanding of Low Voltage Switchgear products (ACB, MCCB, Switchboards) and IEC/IS standards (especially IEC 61439). Skills & Competencies Technical Expertise: Strong background in design, testing, and troubleshooting of switchgear components and panels. Training Skills: Expertise in instructional design, adult learning principles, and modern training technologies. Leadership: Proven ability to manage teams and drive initiatives across multiple locations. Communication: Excellent interpersonal skills to engage both shop-floor technicians and senior R&D management. Preferred Qualifications Certification in Training & Development. Six Sigma Black Belt Experience with Learning Management Systems (LMS) and e-learning creation tools. title: Integration (Electronic and Mechanical) Engineering - Senior Professional
jobDescription: MISSION The primary objective of this role is to carry out the design engineering for the development of Low Voltage (LV) Circuit Breakers / Switches and associated accessories. The role focuses on delivering innovative, cost-effective, and standards-compliant (IEC..) solutions tailored to customer-specific technical and market requirements. The candidate will be actively involved in all phases of the product development lifecycle, from concept through to production readiness. Key Responsibilities Design and develop LV electrical distribution products in alignment with technical specifications and market needs. Lead the end-to-end product development process including design, prototyping, testing, documentation, and manufacturing readiness. Apply hands-on expertise in LV products such as MCCBs / ACBs / switches as well as accessories. Improve thermal performance, electrical life, short circuit performance of product. Use good understanding of current density, contact buttons, venting, and arcing for product improvement. Improve based on observations & graphs generated during testing. Conduct detailed engineering analysis using design fundamentals and tools (e.g., material strength, tolerance stack-up, mechanism design). Utilize 3D CAD software (e.g., Pro/ENGINEER) for complex design feasibility studies and modeling. Demonstrate strong knowledge of manufacturing processes and tooling for both metallic and plastic components. Perform Design for Manufacturing (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA) evaluations, recommending alternative materials and production methods. Conduct design for reliability & robustness. Apply six sigma requirements like QFD, DFMEA, P-Diagram Manage prototype development, build, and testing activities. Conduct root cause analysis and implement corrective actions for design issues. Collaborate with cross-functional teams including manufacturing, sourcing, finance, marketing, and suppliers to ensure design validation and production readiness. Define & carry out product qualification as well as validation testing. Support certification testing as per IEC testing (IEC 60947) using knowledge of standard, test procedure & acceptance criteria. Root cause analysis in case of failure. Maintain and update comprehensive product documentation including drawings, BOMs, and design guidelines. Develop and update product documentation including drawings, BOM's and design guides. Product release in PDM softwares Qualifications & Skills Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) preferred Masters (M Tech or equivalent) in Electrical / Electrical & Electronics Engineering. 6 to 10 years of experience in the design and development of low voltage electrical distribution devices / circuit breakers. Proven expertise in product design, production engineering, and value engineering. Understanding of current density benchmarking, design philosophy of arcing, venting, contact system etc. Understanding of product testing as per IEC 60947. Knowledge of test procedures, acceptance criteria. Ability to analyze graphs & bring inference out of testing. Knowledge of LV circuit breakers (ACB / MCCB), product costing, and quality standards. jobDescription: INTRODUCTION: The Busway business is one of the fast-growing product lines within Low Voltage Power Products, manufacturing sheet-metal fabricated busway enclosures, housings, joints and copper/aluminium bus-bar assemblies for power distribution. title: Associate Central Investigator
jobDescription: Mission The Associate Central Investigator plays a critical role in ensuring thorough and effective investigations of Trust Line alerts, mainly those classified as medium to high in severity and complexity. These alerts pertain to potential business misconduct, including bribery and corruption, fraudulent reporting, asset misappropriation, and conflicts of interest. The mission involves combating such fraud by investigating allegations raised by whistleblowers or by identifying anomalies through Artificial Intelligence. All investigations are conducted in alignment with the Trust Charter and in strict compliance with applicable laws and local regulations. jobDescription: Key Responsibilities Requirements Engineering & Traceability Lead definition, decomposition, and validation of hardware requirements from system and stakeholder inputs (functional, electrical, environmental, safety, regulatory).
